title: 第23章 突破先天境第24章 考核开始
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 李轩看到乾坤戒，眼睛也是忍不住一亮，立即就接了过来。
当看到乾坤戒中那密密麻麻的灵石时，他顿时就忍不住咧开嘴笑了起来。
灵石啊。
虽然这玩意对于曾经的他来说，就跟垃圾差不多，哪怕丢在地上，他都根本懒得去捡。
可对现在的他来说，却是宝贵的修炼资源啊。
此次挑战，炼气境报名19人，先天境一重23人，先天境二重2人，先天境三重1人。
按照他当初定下来的费用，先天境之下200枚下品灵石，先天境一重1000枚，先天境二重2000枚，先天境三重5000枚。
一共加起来，那就是足足枚下品灵石。
撇开给杨家的三成，他能够落在手里的，都足足有着枚。
“哈哈哈，这下子，本少主应该足以突破到先天了。”
李轩看着那些灵石，笑的那叫一个合不拢嘴。
就连鼎爷，都是忍不住发出了开怀大笑声：
“不错，小子你很不错，鼎爷我总算是也能够吸收一些灵石了，特喵的每天吃死人，都快要吃吐了。”
他也没有计较那60枚灵石的零头，直接取走，剩下的递给了杨芊芊：“少族长，这些还请收下。”
“李公子客气了。”杨芊芊微微一笑，并没有推辞，接了过去。
她俏脸忽然一红：“若是不嫌弃，以后便叫我芊芊吧，少族长显得有些太生分了。”
李轩微微一愣，旋即点头，“好。”
杨辰诡异的看着杨芊芊，忽然脱口道：“姐，你的脸怎么红了，不会是看上我大哥了吧？”
唰。
此言一出，杨芊芊俏脸顿时更红了，差点没找个地缝钻下去。
那娇羞的表情，简直都能迷死个人。
李轩则是在心中大呼卧槽，这个杨辰有些愣啊。
“我先回去修炼了。”他留下一句话，落荒而逃。
既然修炼资源已经到手，那他接下来就要准备突破先天了。
好刀自然得用在钢刃上，修炼资源这种东西，唯有变成修为才是最实际的。
否则，一旦自己死了，便宜了别人，那才叫冤种。
李轩走后，杨芊芊抬手就一巴掌呼在了杨辰脑袋上。
“你小子乱说什么呢？”
杨辰眼中却是闪烁着精明，“姐，我不是觉得大哥不错吗？这样的人一旦错过可就没有了。若是你喜欢，可要抓住机会啊。”
李轩进入房间之后，只是微微调整了一下状态，就把所有灵石都给了鼎爷。
“哈哈哈，爽，爽啊。”
鼎爷收走那些灵石，顿时忍不住开怀大笑了起来，笑的那叫一个阴险。
没多久，一股股无比精纯的能量便是反馈出来，源源不断的涌入了李轩体内。
李轩没有犹豫，立即开始运转凡人诀，开始了吸收修炼。
同一时刻。
content_en:
When Li Xuan saw the Qiankun Ring, his eyes couldn't help but light up, and he immediately took it.
When he saw the densely packed spiritual stones in the Qiankun Ring, he couldn't help but grin.
Spiritual stone.
Although this thing was almost like garbage to him, even if it was thrown on the ground, he would not bother to pick it up.
But for him now, it is a precious cultivation resource.
For this challenge, 19 people signed up for the Qi Refining Realm, 23 people at the first level of the Xiantian Realm, 2 people at the second level of the Xiantian Realm, and 1 person at the third level of the Xiantian Realm.
According to the cost he originally set, it would be 200 low-grade spiritual stones for the innate realm, 1,000 for the first level of the innate realm, 2,000 for the second level of the innate realm, and 5,000 for the third level of the innate realm.
Added up in total, that is a full number of low-grade spiritual stones.
Leaving aside the 30% given to the Yang family, he had enough in his hands.
"Hahaha, now, this young master should be able to break through to Xiantian."
Li Xuan looked at the spirit stones and smiled so hard that he couldn't close his mouth from ear to ear.
Even Master Ding couldn't help but laugh heartily:
"Yes, boy, you are very good. Master Ding, I have finally been able to absorb some spiritual stones. I eat dead people every day and almost vomit."
Li Xuan: "..."
He didn't care about the fraction of the 60 spirit stones and took them away directly. He handed the rest to Yang Qianqian: "Young Patriarch, please accept these."
"You're welcome, Mr. Li." Yang Qianqian smiled slightly and accepted it without refusing.
Her pretty face suddenly turned red: "If you don't mind, just call me Qianqian from now on. The young patriarch seems a little too rude."
Li Xuan was stunned for a moment, then nodded, "Okay."
Yang Chen looked at Yang Qianqian strangely, and suddenly blurted out: "Sister, why is your face red? Could it be that you have a crush on my elder brother?"
Uh-huh.
As soon as these words came out, Yang Qianqian's pretty face turned even redder, and she almost found a way to burrow into the ground.
That shy expression can simply enchant anyone to death.
Li Xuan shouted in his heart, "Fuck", this Yang Chen was a little stunned.
"I'm going back to practice first." He left a word and ran away.
Now that he has obtained the training resources, he must prepare to break through Xiantian.
Naturally, a good sword must be used on a steel blade. For things like cultivation resources, it is most practical to turn them into cultivation.
Otherwise, once you die and benefit others, it will be called an injustice.
After Li Xuan left, Yang Qianqian raised her hand and slapped Yang Chen on the head.
"What are you talking about?"
Yang Chen's eyes shone with shrewdness, "Sister, don't I think Big Brother is pretty good? Once you miss someone like this, there will be no more. If you like it, you have to seize the opportunity."
···
After Li Xuan entered the room, he just adjusted his condition slightly and gave all the spirit stones to Lord Ding.
"Hahaha, it's cool, it's cool."
Master Ding took away the spiritual stones and couldn't help but burst into laughter. His laughter was so sinister.
Not long after, streams of extremely pure energy were fed back, pouring into Li Xuan's body continuously.
Li Xuan did not hesitate and immediately started to run the Mortal Art and began to absorb and practice.
same moment.
